name: todo-webapp

dependencies.name: todo-api
dependencies.description: Calls the to-do API to create, list, update and delete the signed-in user's items.

description: The single-page to-do application: sign-in via Thunder, then add, view, edit, complete/reopen, and delete the signed-in user's own to-do items by calling todo-api. Does not store any data itself and does not offer any admin or shared view.
